title: The Ultimate Shopify Setup & Launch FAQ
description: Everything you need to know about setting up and launching a Shopify store, from domains to basic settings.
h1: The Ultimate Shopify Setup & Launch FAQ (1000+ Answers)

questions.q: What is Shopify and how does it work?
questions.a: Shopify is a cloud-based e-commerce platform that allows you to create, manage, and scale an online store easily without needing to manage servers or complex coding.

questions.q: How much does a Shopify store cost to start?
questions.a: Shopify plans typically start at $39/month (Basic). However, you also need to factor in domain costs (~$14/year), paid apps, and premium themes if you choose not to use the free ones.

questions.q: Do I need a business license to sell on Shopify?
questions.a: Shopify itself does not require a business license, but your local government or state may require one depending on your location and the type of goods you are selling.

questions.q: Can I use my own domain name with Shopify?
questions.a: Yes, you can purchase a domain directly through Shopify or connect a third-party domain from registrars like GoDaddy or Namecheap.

questions.q: Is Shopify good for beginners?
questions.a: Absolutely. Shopify's intuitive drag-and-drop interface, extensive documentation, and responsive support make it one of the most beginner-friendly e-commerce platforms available.

title: Shopify Plus & Enterprise Solutions FAQ
description: Answers to all your questions about Shopify Plus, B2B wholesale, Scripts, Flow, and enterprise e-commerce solutions.
h1: Shopify Plus & Enterprise Solutions FAQ (1000+ Answers)

questions.q: What is Shopify Plus?
questions.a: Shopify Plus is the enterprise-level version of Shopify, designed for high-volume merchants and large businesses, offering advanced customization, API limits, and dedicated support.

questions.q: How much does Shopify Plus cost?
questions.a: Shopify Plus pricing starts at $2,500 per month on a 1-year term, or a variable fee based on your monthly revenue if it exceeds a certain threshold.

questions.q: What are Shopify Scripts?
questions.a: Shopify Scripts allow Plus merchants to write custom Ruby code to create personalized checkout experiences, complex discounts, and specialized shipping rules.

questions.q: Does Shopify Plus support B2B wholesale?
questions.a: Yes, Shopify Plus has built-in B2B features that allow merchants to sell wholesale and retail from the same store, with custom price lists and net payment terms.

questions.q: What is Shopify Flow?
questions.a: Shopify Flow is an e-commerce automation platform exclusive to Plus and Advanced plans that lets you build workflows to automate repetitive tasks like inventory management and fraud prevention.

title: Shopify Theme Customization & Liquid FAQ
description: Expert answers on Shopify theme design, Liquid programming, and speed optimization for your online store.
h1: Shopify Theme Customization & Liquid FAQ (1000+ Answers)

questions.q: What is Shopify Liquid?
questions.a: Liquid is a Ruby-based open-source template language created by Shopify. It is the backbone of all Shopify themes and is used to load dynamic data onto store pages.

questions.q: How do I edit my Shopify theme code?
questions.a: You can edit your theme code by going to Online Store > Themes, clicking the three dots next to your theme, and selecting 'Edit code' to access HTML, CSS, JS, and Liquid files.

questions.q: Why is my Shopify store so slow?
questions.a: Store speed is often affected by large unoptimized images, too many third-party apps, complex theme code, or heavy JavaScript files loaded before the main content.

questions.q: Can I use Bootstrap or Tailwind CSS in Shopify?
questions.a: Yes, you can integrate frameworks like Bootstrap or Tailwind CSS into a custom Shopify theme, though you will need to set up a local build environment using Shopify CLI.

questions.q: How do I hire a good Shopify Developer?
questions.a: Look for developers with a strong portfolio, verified reviews, expertise in Liquid and modern web technologies, and a solid understanding of e-commerce UX and conversions.

title: Shopify SEO & Marketing FAQ
description: Master Shopify SEO, drive traffic, and boost conversions with our comprehensive marketing FAQ for e-commerce.

questions.q: Is Shopify good for SEO?
questions.a: Yes, Shopify has robust built-in SEO features including customizable title tags, meta descriptions, alt text, auto-generated sitemaps, and clean URL structures.

questions.q: How do I submit my Shopify sitemap to Google?
questions.a: You can submit your sitemap by logging into Google Search Console, selecting your property, navigating to 'Sitemaps', and entering 'sitemap.xml'.

questions.q: Why is my Shopify store not showing up on Google?
questions.a: It may take days or weeks for Google to index a new store. Ensure your store is not password-protected and that you have submitted your sitemap to Google Search Console.

questions.q: What is the best SEO app for Shopify?
questions.a: Popular SEO apps include Plug in SEO, SEO Manager, and Yoast SEO for Shopify. However, much of the foundational SEO can be done without paid apps.

questions.q: How can I increase traffic to my Shopify store?
questions.a: Increase traffic through a combination of content marketing (blogging), SEO, social media ads (Facebook/TikTok), influencer partnerships, and email marketing campaigns.

title: Shopify Dropshipping & Store Management FAQ
description: Get all your answers about Shopify dropshipping, inventory management, payments, and shipping logistics.
h1: Shopify Dropshipping & Store Management FAQ (1000+ Answers)

questions.q: What is Shopify Dropshipping?
questions.a: Dropshipping is a retail fulfillment method where you don't keep the products you sell in stock. Instead, when a store sells a product, it purchases the item from a third party and has it shipped directly to the customer.

questions.q: Is dropshipping still profitable in 2026?
questions.a: Yes, but it requires a unique brand, high-quality ad creatives, fast shipping times (using local suppliers), and excellent customer service to stand out from intense competition.

questions.q: What is the best dropshipping app for Shopify?
questions.a: Apps like DSers, Zendrop, Spocket, and CJ Dropshipping are highly rated for finding products and automating order fulfillment on Shopify.

questions.q: What are Shopify Payments?
questions.a: Shopify Payments is Shopify's integrated payment gateway that allows you to accept credit cards directly without third-party integrations and saves you from paying extra transaction fees.

questions.q: How do I handle returns in a dropshipping model?
questions.a: You should clearly outline your return policy. When a customer returns an item, they usually ship it to your address, and you refund them, taking the loss, as most overseas suppliers do not accept returns easily.
